question: Should openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-payload publicly guarantee the generic tool-progress kind and predicate for third-party producers and channels?
rationale: The runtime fix is technically sound, but this patch converts an internal bundled-plugin coordination signal into a durable public API; repository policy and compatibility risk require maintainer intent before that contract ships.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Keep the exports, document that only transient non-semantic tool chrome may carry the kind, and add a focused public SDK contract test.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and route the same invariant through the narrowest existing bundled-only or internal reply metadata seam.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exports, document that only transient non-semantic tool chrome may carry the kind, and add a focused public SDK contract test.
